values.body:
Planned Sunday 27 to Monday 28 December 2026 overnight, Hong Kong/Macau time UTC+8. Treasure Hotel opposite Macau Airport is proposed, NOT BOOKED; INR4,300 is an unverified estimate for one room for two. Verify taxes, room type, cancellation and breakfast before purchase. Keep the confirmed Hong Kong hotel room and main luggage; take a small overnight bag.
Outbound target 27 Dec 08:30 TurboJET Sheung Wan → Outer Harbour; return target 28 Dec 09:00 Cotai Water Jet Taipa → Sheung Wan. Both remain PLACEHOLDER; published schedules are not date-specific availability. Allow about 50–55 minutes at terminals and follow actual boarding cutoffs.
Bungy is PLACEHOLDER: target 14:00 on 27 Dec, ticketing-counter arrival 13:30. Allow 13:30–16:00; no guaranteed finish. Verify Meghana’s spectator/observation ticket and viewing deck.
Carry both passports, valid Hong Kong re-entry documents, actual confirmations once booked and small MOP cash. Enable Macau data for BOTH 27 and 28 Dec, checking activation, validity and expiry. Keep current payment guidance: do not assume standard Hong Kong Adult On-Loan Octopus works on Macau buses; use cards for larger purchases where accepted. No beef or beef broth.
Skip pandas by default; Monte Fort, Fisherman’s Wharf and Golden Reel are untimed optional references only. Recheck ferries, shuttles/bays, festive shows and Parisian deck closure 1–2 weeks before departure; no reminder automation created.

Verify activation time, calendar-day versus rolling validity, expiry/timezone and data allowance; do not assume one one-day package covers the overnight.

values.body:
Planning estimates include walking, waiting and traffic; shuttle seats and hotel access are not reserved.
Default: Outer Harbour → Senado taxi; historic centre → Tower taxi (13:00–13:30 protects check-in); Tower → Treasure taxi, 20–30 min driving plus queue, MOP100–150 planning fare for the car.
Treasure → airport shuttle area → Wynn Palace: airport departures published 09:05–21:00 every 20 min, confirm signed bay. Allow 30–40 min door-to-door; leave hotel 16:50 if queues. The reverse Palace → HZMB → Taipa Ferry → Airport → Palace loop is 30–40 min, not a direct reverse trip. LRT fallback: Airport towards Barra → MUST → Cotai East, then walk.
Wynn → Venetian: taxi, allow 20 min with pickup, MOP40–70 planning fare; walk alternative 25–35 min between actual entrances. No current direct Wynn–Venetian free shuttle verified; do not use old 2018/2019 Cotai Connection PDFs.
Venetian → Parisian → Londoner: signed pedestrian connections/bridges/crossings, allow 15–20 min each leg including internal resort walks.
Londoner → Treasure after 21:45: taxi simplest, 10–15 min driving plus pickup, allow 30 min, MOP50–80 planning fare. LRT fallback via Cotai East towards Taipa Ferry Terminal to Airport via MUST; allow 30–45 min and check last train. No late free shuttle assumed.
Optional free shuttles (recheck bays/holiday operation): Airport ↔ Venetian West Lobby 10:00–22:00 every 12–15 min (official timetable effective 13 Oct 2026), allow 30–40 min door-to-door including 10–15 min driving. Wynn Macau ↔ Wynn Palace 09:30–22:00 every 15–20 min, about 25 min ride plus walks/wait. Wynn Palace → Old Taipa Village → Lisboeta → Palace Thu–Sun 12:00–21:00 every 30 min; not a general resort circuit. Venetian Main Lobby → Taipa ferry 08:10–23:35, reverse 08:45–23:59 every 15–18 min (12–15 min 10:30–21:30). Sands Londoner/Parisian/Venetian circuit from Venetian 11:15–21:15, towards Venetian 11:00–21:00 every 15–18 min; not a late return option.
For Monday ferry use Airport LRT one stop to Taipa Ferry; no early hotel shuttle assumed. Taxi fares are estimates for the car, subject to meter/traffic. Outbound from Yau Ma Tei: MTR via Central to Sheung Wan, 45–50 min with walks; ask the hotel for a current cross-harbour taxi/toll quote if preferred.
values.summary: Default taxis + airport → Wynn shuttle · LRT backup · No late free shuttle assumption

values.title: Cotai evening — shows, closures and fallback order
values.body:
27 Dec targets: Wynn 17:30–18:15 → Venetian 18:35–19:25 → Parisian exterior 19:45 → Londoner Crystal Palace guard 20:30 (arrive 20:20) → dinner 20:50 → outdoor facade 21:30 → Treasure taxi 21:45. Guard is inside; facade is outside at a different time.
Wynn SkyCab Sunday published 16:00–22:00, last entry 21:40; skip ride if queue above 25–30 min and enjoy Performance Lake. Venetian interiors/canals need no gambling; gondola is separately paid with no queue time reserved; no additional fixed teamLab stop.
Parisian observation decks listed CLOSED 26 Dec 2026–1 Jan 2027. Exterior only; do not buy deck tickets. General illumination every 15 min 18:15–00:00: target 19:45, 20:00 fallback; recheck festive lighting/suspensions because deck closure does not guarantee lights.
Londoner Changing of the Guard: Crystal Palace lobby, Sunday 16:00 / 18:00 / 20:30, closed Mondays. Target 20:20 arrival; finish is a planning allowance. Optional if bungy/traffic runs late. Facade light/sound show: outdoors, daily 19:30–23:30 hourly; target 21:30.
Snack at hotel rest because dinner is later. If hungry earlier, eat at Venetian and skip guard show. Never delay meals for photos. If bungy overruns, shorten Venetian, omit guard show or skip SkyCab queue; protect transfers/meals. Published schedules from the supplied 27–28 October brief require date-specific/festive reconfirmation.
values.summary: SkyCab queue limit · Parisian exterior only · Indoor guard 20:30 / outdoor facade 21:30

values.title: Pandas — skip by default; Sunday alternative only
values.body:
Default: skip pandas. Macao Giant Panda Pavilion is at Seac Pai Van Park, Coloane. Published tourism hours 10:00–13:00 and 14:00–17:00; last entry 16:45; normally closed Mondays, with holiday exceptions. Recheck maintenance, holiday access and admission. Monday 28 Dec is not a reliable viewing day. A 14:00 bungy may finish too late; do not squeeze pandas between Tower and Treasure.
Mutually exclusive alternative ONLY if pandas become a priority: choose 07:30 TurboJET to Outer Harbour, shorten historic centre, omit Fisherman’s Wharf/Monte Fort; REQUEST 12:00 bungy if available and check in 11:30 (requires changing unbooked placeholder, not an assumed reservation). If finished about 14:00, taxi 25–35 min towards the park, visit roughly 14:45–15:45, taxi 20–30 min to Treasure. Evening resorts only as energy/time permit. If bungy runs late, skip pandas. No guaranteed jump finish, panda activity or sightings.
Monte Fort, Fisherman’s Wharf and Golden Reel remain untimed optional references outside the core route.
values.summary: Skip pandas · Monday normally closed · Earlier ferry/bungy alternative is mutually exclusive
